metas.name: Dallas Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
In addition to standard Texas windshield sticker on rare occasion in Dallas, you can see small T-sticker on cars that are suspected to be abandoned or scheduled for towing.

The sticker is placed in top center of the windshield.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Hawaii Bumper Sticker
metas.note: Hawaii uses bumper sticker instead of windshield sticker. Color and shape are consistent since 2013
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Louisiana Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Louisiana sticker looks like perfect square when on windshield and features state outline on it.

You should see it in white or fade yellow collor.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Maine Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Maine sticker always has a chunk missing from it.

The sticker color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Massachusetts Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
The number is placed in center above bar code.

The sticker is placed on passenger's side.

Color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Missouri Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
This one has a big one white bar above 'Missouri' name and month is marked with black dot.

The sticker color changes annually.

Missouri stickers on street view are not a common sight because only cars with 150k+ mileage or 10+ years old cars have to have it.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: New Hampshire Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
New Hampshire sticker has a thick colorful outline around white rectangle.

The sticker color changes annually.

Since February 2026 stickers are no longer required.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: New Orleans Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
New Orleans City in Louisiana has a unique circular sticker.

The sticker color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: New York Windshield Sticker
metas.note: New York uses 2 stickers on windshield. The bigger one is in light colors (white, pale yellow, light grey) while smaller one changes color annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Pennsylvania Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Pennsylvania uses 2 stickers on windshield with visibly big font for numbers.

The sticker's color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Rhode Island Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Rhode Island sticker has a big white patch in bottom left corner.

The sticker is placed on passenger's side.

The sticker's color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Texas Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Texas sticker has a blue outline over white rectangle.

Color of the sticker is consistent every year.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Vermont Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Vermont sticker has a qr code on the right side.

The sticker color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Virginia Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
Virginia's sticker has a big number on the left side while the second number on the right is a lot smaller.

The sticker color changes annually.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Washington D.C. Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
This one has a blue top and blue bottom bars that don't reach the edges. This pattern has been consistent for many years.

Relatively few cars are registered in D.C., so this sticker is not commonly seen
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: West Virginia Windshield Sticker
metas.note:
This one has a big colorful rectangle attached to small white one.

The sticker color changes every 2 years.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.
